card.name: Binary digits and compass bearings
card.fires_on: Binary digit strings (0s and 1s) and the words around binary or base notation in technical text. Also the 'S' of compass bearings like SSW in distance tables.

modes.label: Binary digits
modes.description: A 0 or 1 inside a bit pattern or binary range in technical documentation.
modes.example: fetches (nOPC=0 and MAS[1:0]=1<<0>>). Article last edited on: 2

modes.label: Binary or base wording
modes.description: Words or punctuation just before a stated number base such as binary (base 2).
modes.example: #B-- the integer is written<< in>> binary (base 2) #O

modes.label: Compass bearing
modes.description: The S starting SSW in a city distance table.

card.writes: It pushes against direction words like north, left, east and south, and favors odd word-start pieces.
card.plain: It fires on binary numbers such as 001 or 111 and on text about binary bases, and occasionally on compass bearings like SSW.
